futureMilestones.title: Wagmi treasury swap
futureMilestones.summary: RingTreasurySwap.sol + quote/execute APIs + oracle/FX desk shipped (1.97.12). Remaining: production allowlist hardening + ops runbook closeout.

futureMilestones.title: Solana NFT Gate production
futureMilestones.summary: Gate TS + membership/public-pool program source advanced (1.97.12). Remaining: GateEscrow PDA production deploy + sponsored feePayer.

futureMilestones.title: Intent-driven збірка кілець
